about: S&S price book v1 (19 Nov 2026): the 14 Nov workbook's figures, the parts the design-your-own builder needs, the prices researched on 19 Nov, and the builder's rules. Edited in the Google Sheet 'S&S price book'. Each entry's 'kaspar' is his own figure and wins over ours. Built by Flowtoform Limited.

rules.label: Is S&S VAT registered? (No = supplier VAT is a cost to him)

labour.basis: Assumption.

labour.task: Fit a pull-out, a jewellery drawer or shoe storage (BUILDER)
labour.basis: Assumption.

labour.task: Fit and adjust push to open (BUILDER)

labour.task: Veneer work: matching grain, veneer edging, sanding and protecting the finish (BUILDER)
labour.basis: Calibrated 19 Nov 2026 to his 16 published guide prices (fitted inside a plausible range); his own timing replaces it. Oak was 20 to 30% under his prices without it.

labour.task: Travel and parking time, per site day
labour.basis: Assumption: London traffic and parking.

labour.task: Finish tongue and groove doors: extra prep and paint into the grooves (BUILDER)
labour.basis: Assumption: about 12 minutes a m2 more than a flat door. For outsourced spraying it stands in for the finisher's extra.

labour.task: Finish fluted doors: extra sanding and paint into every reed (BUILDER)
labour.basis: Assumption: a fluted face has about half as much surface again as a flat one and every reed is sanded by hand. For outsourced spraying it stands in for the finisher's extra.

labour.task: Veneer work inside: edging, sanding and protecting an oak inside (BUILDER)
labour.basis: Assumption: an oak inside is lacquered by the finisher like the outside, but needs no grain matching.
